quotes.speaker: Tyler Herro
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyler Herro on the team's need for consistent ball movement
quotes.excerpt: We play best when we're moving that ball, when the ball has pop to it.
quotes.quote: We just got away from our game. We play best when we're moving that ball, when the ball has pop to it. We just got to get to it and be more consistent with it.
quotes.social_post: Tyler Herro says the Bucks need to get back to their identity. We play best when we are moving that ball and the ball has pop to it.

structured.context: Tyler Herro discusses the team's need for more consistent ball movement following a loss.

quotes.speaker: Tyler Herro
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyler Herro on the team's struggle with individual versus team play
quotes.excerpt: We got to play team ball, that's what it's all about.
quotes.quote: Things happen. Guys want to score, guys want to play their game a little bit, but we got to play team ball, that's what it's all about.
quotes.social_post: Tyler Herro on the Bucks offensive struggles. Guys want to score and play their game a little bit but we have to play team ball.

structured.context: Tyler Herro reflects on the team's struggle to prioritize team play over individual scoring efforts.

quotes.speaker: Tyler Herro
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyler Herro on defensive lapses and the team's slow-paced offense
quotes.excerpt: It was a slower-paced game and the way that they switch everything naturally that slows teams down.
quotes.quote: It was a slower-paced game and the way that they switch everything naturally that slows teams down offensively, which is why we scored what we scored. I think that's why the more we move the ball, the more we play off each other when teams are switching, is going to help us. But it was a low-scoring game because of how they muck things up defensively and I still thought we could have been better on our side of the ball defensively. I felt like their players were too comfortable getting to their spots, especially early on and then Randle especially got going, was comfortable and he obviously won them the game.
quotes.social_post: Tyler Herro credits the opponent for mucking up the game defensively but admits the Bucks were too comfortable letting players like Julius Randle get to their spots.

structured.context: Tyler Herro analyzes the team's defensive performance and the impact of Julius Randle on the game outcome.
